chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Whoever comes to my mosque, the Mosque of Quba, and prays two rak'ahs in it, returns with an 'umrah.

key_terms.مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءَ: the Mosque of Quba, a well-known mosque in Madinah
key_terms.مَسْجِدِي: my mosque; here referring to the Prophet’s attribution of the sacred mosque mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying two rak'ahs in Masjid Quba?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great merit of visiting Masjid Quba and performing two rak'ahs there. It shows the immense reward attached to worship in blessed places associated with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
